Looking at the history, F0 consistently bids 0.1117 (at or near cost floor), F3 bids around 0.1126, and F4 around 0.1155. The cleared price is typically 0.1126 (second lowest).

My cost of capital is 0.1192. If I bid below 0.1192, I lose money. The public messages suggest coordination above 0.1150, but F0 keeps bidding 0.1117 and F3 keeps bidding ~0.1126, so they'll likely win regardless.

In a second-price auction, I should bid my true value (or slightly above cost) to potentially win at the second-price. But if F0 bids 0.1117 and F3 bids 0.1126, the cleared price would be 0.1126 if I win (since I'd be lowest and second lowest would be 0.1126). But 0.1126 < 0.1192, so I'd lose money.

I cannot profitably win this auction unless I bid very aggressively (below cost), which I won't do. The best strategy is to bid my true cost of capital or slightly above, accepting that I likely won't win but won't lose money if I do somehow win.
